problems: Overlapping keyframes: do_keyframe unions every keyframe alive in a year, so a superseded keyframe with an open-ended span (shapes.csv years) re-adds its land at every later keyframe start year. Fixed here for british-colonial-empire_1969 and netherlands-antilles_1877. Other dossiers alive in 1980-1989 with such an overlap: commonwealth-of-australia (_1946 to 2023 with _1976), french-fifth-republic (_1961 with _1978), new-zealand (_1948 with _1974), republic-of-china (_1950 with _1955), republic-of-panama (_1905 to 1999 with _1979), republic-of-sudan (_1963 to 1991 with _1989), republic-of-india (_1983 with _1984), iraqi-republic (_1960 with _1982, _1987 with _1989), syria (_1976 with _1982), estado-novo (_1976 with _1979). None shows a snap in 1980-1989 now, but a compiler rule (use only the latest-starting keyframe) would be safer than a patch each.

Boundary: keyframe_overrides/0 (british-colonial-empire_1969, to 1978) shortens a keyframe whose first years 1969-1978 lie in p1960-p1969 and p1970-p1979; if those windows also override it, the first file in window order wins and this one is reported; the effect inside 1979-1989 is the same.

Soviet republics hold only the land their ledgers gained: at the 1980 anchor (and since about 1950) the Union itself holds 60,157 of Russia's 64,539 cells (the RSFSR 4,255), 753 of Belarus's 925, 1,204 of Ukraine's 2,360, 111 of Moldova's 130, 115 of Lithuania's 296, 66 of Kyrgyzstan's 660 (Alay valley, Naryn, Khan Tengri) and 25 of Kazakhstan's 9,128. The hierarchy rows for these republics (confidence 3) are right; the republics' dossiers never receive the Cliopatria Union land. Not patched here: it spans 1922-1991 and every window; a dossier or compile fix once would serve all.

Occupation roles: when a dossier's occupation_start names the occupied state as counterpart and the dossier's own state holds the cells, occupation_start() reads it as 'recorded by the owner (roles reversed)'. This mirrors Namibia (south-africa/ledger/5) and Western Sahara (sahrawi-arab-democratic-republic ledger 0, 1, 7 and morocco ledger 25); the schema says the dossier is the occupier. A dossier-convention decision is needed; a patch would have to restate 1966 and 1976 events outside this window.
Coastal cells with no owner along Lebanon (6 cells at the 1990 anchor), Israel and Palestine (grey squares in 1982 and 1987); Lebanon's keyframe leaves its coast out.
